description:
Manage Focus deep-links with the following actions:

- **get**: Build Toggl 2.0 web URLs (and Track URLs where IDs map) for a task, project, time entry, calendar day, report or member. Read-only; makes no API calls. member id is the organization user ID. time_entry needs task_id to open the entry itself. report_type defaults to summary; set period (preset) or from/to (YYYY-MM-DD) for a date range. track.url is null with a note when the IDs do not map to Track. (data: entity*, id, task_id, project_id, date, report_type, period, from, to, tab)

Pass the action-specific fields under `data` (required fields are marked with *).
Mutations require a confirm_token handshake: call without confirm_token first to receive a token, then call again with the token to confirm.
Optional dry_run: true validates input and returns { dry_run, operation, input } without calling the API.

confirm_token.description: Mutation confirmation token from previous call
